entries.title: Your panels can work with your tasks
entries.body: A panel Firstmate builds for you, or one you add, can now list your tasks with the app's own status marks, open a task when you click it, and show who is on it when you rest on it. It can queue, start or drop a task when you click in it; one you add asks you first, on the card that adds it. A collapsed panel now says what it holds in its header, and a panel's card stays as you left it while you page through your cards.

picture.alt: A Task desk panel listing three tasks with their status marks and Queue buttons, and the crew summary of the task the pointer rests on beside it
